title: On first entering the Kingswood ('The East Track'), all four companions spoke TWICE in a row with two overlapping-but-different sets of remarks fired back to back on the same turn (e.g. Vell: 'I don't think that's coincidence...' immediately followed by Vell: 'The records say the hunt was not recalled...'), reading as a doubled arrival-banter trigger rather than one clean introduction.
